title: Lasagna alla Bolognese
method: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté onion, carrots, celery, and garlic until softened.
Add ground beef and pork; cook until browned.
Pour in red wine and simmer until reduced by half.
Add crushed tomatoes, milk, salt, and pepper. Simmer on low heat for 1.5–2 hours.
Cook lasagna noodles until al dente.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, béchamel, mozzarella, and Parmesan in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
method: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Sauté guanciale until crispy; remove from heat.
Whisk eggs, yolks, and Pecorino in a bowl.
Drain pasta and add to guanciale pan.
Remove from heat and stir in egg mixture quickly to create a creamy sauce.
Season generously with black pepper.

title: Margherita Pizza
method: Preheat oven to 500°F (260°C).
Stretch dough into a circle and spread tomato sauce.
Top with mozzarella slices and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake 10–12 minutes until crust is golden.
Top with fresh basil before serving.

title: Risotto alla Milanese
method: Sauté onion in butter until translucent.
Add rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Pour in wine and cook until absorbed.
Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly.
Stir in saffron halfway through cooking.
Finish with Parmesan and remaining butter.

title: Osso Buco
method: Season veal shanks with salt and pepper; dredge in flour.
Brown shanks in olive oil and set aside.
Sauté onion, carrots, celery, and garlic.
Add wine and reduce by half.
Add tomatoes and broth; return shanks to pot.
Simmer covered for 2 hours until tender.
Serve with gremolata sprinkled on top.

title: Pesto Genovese
method: Blend basil, Parmesan, pine nuts, and garlic.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil until smooth.
Season with salt.
Serve with pasta or as a spread.

title: Tiramisu
method: Whisk yolks and sugar over a double boiler until thick.
Fold in mascarpone.
Whip cream and fold into mixture.
Dip ladyfingers in espresso and layer with cream mixture.
Dust with cocoa and chill 4 hours.

title: Minestrone Soup
method: Sauté onion, carrots, and celery in olive oil.
Add potatoes, zucchini, beans, tomatoes, and broth.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Season and serve.

title: Focaccia
method: Mix water, yeast, and sugar; rest 10 minutes.
Add flour, salt, and olive oil; knead until smooth.
Rise 1 hour.
Spread dough on a baking sheet, dimple surface, add rosemary.
Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Piccata
method: Dredge chicken in flour and season.
Brown in butter and olive oil.
Add wine and reduce.
Add lemon juice and capers; simmer 5 minutes.

title: Gnocchi al Pomodoro
method: Sauté garlic in olive oil.
Add tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Cook gnocchi until they float.
Toss with sauce and top with Parmesan and basil.

title: Arancini
method: Form risotto into balls with mozzarella in the center.
Dredge in flour, dip in eggs, coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden.

title: Panna Cotta
method: Bloom gelatin in cold water.
Heat cream, sugar, and vanilla until warm.
Stir in gelatin until dissolved.
Pour into molds and chill 4 hours.

title: Caprese Salad
method: Arrange tomatoes and mozzarella on a plate.
Top with basil.
Drizzle with olive oil and season.

title: Pasta e Fagioli
method: Sauté onion, carrots, celery, and garlic.
Add beans, tomatoes, and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Season and serve.
